findings.observation: The square compact adult face, full cheeks, sharp heavy brows, broad low nose bridge, full closed lips, light skin value, cheek scar, and short stubble preserve Nelor Esha as the unmistakable summon identity rather than a generic doll face.
The chibi retains Nelor’s exceptional coherent bodybuilder mass, broad shoulders, very thick torso, powerful legs, and grounded posture without introducing softness or a different body construction.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and hands remain proportionate to the summon’s extreme bodybuilder build; the compact chibi treatment does not add disproportionate arm or hand inflation.
The matte gray-white-silver curls preserve the dense front and side coil-halo silhouette, swept parting, gathered crown mass, and close side contour of the summon with no added accent.

Terracotta-black lightly quilted outerwear, dark fitted underlayer, four low-profile toggles, waist wrap, tapered trousers, articulated knee folds, weathered boots, tally cord, cheek scar, and the single bounded geometric forearm tattoo all remain legible; no new accessory is introduced.

Original-resolution producer measurement places the complete head-and-hair unit at roughly 38 percent of standing figure height, about 2.6 heads tall. This is larger than the required 32–36 percent and shorter than the required 2.75–3.1-head range.
Exactly one subject appears; the complete coil halo, both empty clenched hands, both trouser legs, and both boots are fully visible with generous safe margins and no duplicated anatomy.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, separated limbs, broad silhouette, empty fists, contrasting coat, and clean parchment field remain readable at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The repaired quilted cloth, plain layers, trousers, boots, tattoo, scar, and tally cord remain ordinary mortal design. No weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
